instruction: I want the italicized words to be more prominent. Please add underline formatting to all italic text in this document while keeping the italic formatting intact.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding underline to all italic text. Evaluator checks if all 21 italic runs also have underline formatting. Verified document has 21 italic text runs that need underline formatting applied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: all italic text has underline applied AND italic formatting is preserved
Logic is sound: iterates through all paragraphs/runs, counts italic runs, checks if they have underline, returns 1.0 only if all italic text is underlined
Proper edge case handling: missing file, document parsing errors, no italic text, empty text runs
Postconfig correctly saves document (Ctrl+S) before evaluation to ensure fresh file state
Data flow is correct: getter extracts .docx from VM, metric opens with python-docx library and checks formatting
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Function signature uses (path1, path2) instead of standard (result, expected, **options) pattern for rule-based metrics. While this works functionally (empty rules dict not needed), it deviates from framework conventions.
